title: 美联储主席沃什面临艰难首秀 利率决策受多重压力
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Joining us now, Ira Jersey, chief U.S. interest rate strategist for Bloomberg intelligence.
segments.zh: 现在连线的是彭博智库的美国利率策略主管艾拉·泽西。

segments.en: All right, this has been a long time coming. But what are you expecting to hear from Warsh on Wednesday?
segments.zh: 好，这一天终于来了。你预计沃什周三会说什么？

segments.en: And is he in a bit of a no-win situation, at least for now?
segments.zh: 他是不是有点进退两难，至少目前是这样？

segments.en: I do think that he's in a little bit of a no-win situation because it's going to be very difficult for the Federal Reserve to produce interest rate, which, of course,
segments.zh: 我确实认为他有点进退两难，因为美联储很难降低利率，

segments.en: President Trump has said that he wants Kevin Warsh to do.
segments.zh: 而特朗普总统希望凯文·沃什这么做。

segments.en: And what he said, he thinks Kevin Warsh will do. But firstly, Kevin Warsh can't do it because he's only one member of the committee, and that's one of the big things.
segments.zh: 而且他认为沃什会这么做。但首先，沃什做不到，因为他只是委员会的一员，这是关键。

segments.en: So what I'm looking forward to hearing from him is one, how his relationship is with his fellow FOMC members.
segments.zh: 所以我期待听到的是，第一，他与FOMC其他成员的关系如何。

segments.en: And then secondly, his outlook and the outlook of the committee for the future of interest rates.
segments.zh: 第二，他本人及委员会对未来利率的展望。

segments.en: If we do actually have a conclusion to the Iran War, you could see maybe a further reduction in oil prices.
segments.zh: 如果伊朗战争真的结束，油价可能进一步下跌。

segments.en: And maybe that gives a little less chance of an interest rate increase later in the year.
segments.zh: 这可能会降低今年晚些时候加息的可能性。

segments.en: And you have seen some of that price out of the market on Friday, certainly.
segments.zh: 周五市场确实已经部分消化了这些影响。

segments.en: And then secondly, if there is any movement or what movement he expects to have on communications policy, which was another thing that he had mentioned
segments.zh: 其次，他预期在沟通政策上会有哪些变动，这也是他之前提到希望改革的方向。

segments.en: that he'd like to see changed. So I hear when they sit around the big table in the Eccles building this week, they're going to look at all of the economic data points
segments.zh: 我听说本周他们在埃克尔斯大楼的大桌旁开会时，会审视所有已公布的经济数据。

segments.en: that they've gone. Indeed, we're going to get a few more here before that meeting kicks off.
segments.zh: 确实，在会议开始前我们还会得到更多数据。

segments.en: But I think of the major price pressures. I think of that better than expected.
segments.zh: 但我认为主要的价格压力比预期要好。
